draft_text: Meridian Logistics Inc. filed a complaint for breach of contract against Northgate Packaging Solutions LLC on July 8, 2021 [E1]. The parties entered into a written Supply Agreement on January 15, 2021, under which Northgate was to deliver 50,000 corrugated shipping containers per month at a fixed price of $2.40 per unit [E1]. A dispute arose around March 2021 when Northgate delivered only 32,000 units, falling approximately 18,000 units short of the minimum required [E1]. On April 2, 2021, Meridian sent a written notice of breach, demanding a cure within 30 days [E1]. Northgate did not cure the breach; deliveries dropped to 21,000 units in May 2021, and on June 10, 2021, Northgate suspended all shipments indefinitely, citing a raw material shortage [E1]. As a result of the suspension, Meridian had to purchase replacement containers on the open market at $3.85 per unit, claiming approximately $1.2 million in cover damages [E1]. Meridian seeks compensatory damages of at least $1,200,000, plus pre-judgment interest and costs [E1].
